item.title: US expands travel ban to 20 more countries and Palestinian Authority
item.description: The Trump administration has widened US travel restrictions, adding 20 more countries and imposing fresh limits on individuals travelling on Palestinian Authority-issued documents, citing national security and public safety concerns.

item.title: Rupee swings sharply in early trade amid crude relief and trade deal worries
item.description: The rupee saw sharp volatility in early trade on Wednesday, with support from softer crude oil prices being countered by uncertainty surrounding an India–US trade deal and continued foreign fund outflows.

item.title: ‘Homebound’ shortlisted for Oscars in international feature category
item.description: Neeraj Ghaywan's Homebound, the much-acclaimed drama about two rural friends and their aspirations, has been shortlisted in the best international feature category at the Oscars alongside 14 other films.

item.title: Karnataka Congress protests MGNREGA renaming and National Herald case politics
item.description: The Karnataka Congress on Wednesday staged a major protest against the central government’s move to rename the rural employment law MGNREGA and alleged “hate politics” targeting the party leadership in the National Herald case.

item.title: EV funding row: 16 US states sue Trump administration over federal freeze
item.description: States allege over $2 billion for electric vehicle infrastructure unlawfully withheld despite congressional approval

item.title: Fresh firing near Manipur’s Bishnupur–Churachandpur border; security stepped up
item.description: No injuries reported; incident triggers renewed displacement in violence-hit areas

item.title: US unemployment rises to 4-year high as jobs data deepens fed rate debate
item.description: Mixed November labour market report shows higher joblessness, uneven hiring and data distortions after government shutdown

item.title: Jaipur electoral rolls cut, over 61,000 removed from CM’s Sanganer seat
item.description: Jaipur’s electoral rolls see major shake-up as 5.36 lakh names removed across 17 Assembly seats under Special Intensive Revision, excluding about 1 in 9 voters.

item.title: Supreme Court collegium clears two names for Punjab and Haryana High Court
item.description: The Supreme Court collegium has recommended the elevation of two judicial officers as judges of the Punjab and Haryana High Court, continuing the process of filling vacancies in the higher judiciary.

item.title: Birch nightclub co-owners brought to Goa after Thailand deportation
item.description: The co-owners of the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub, Gaurav and Saurabh Luthra, were brought to Goa from Delhi on Wednesday after being deported from Thailand in connection with the December 6 fire that claimed 25 lives.
